plotSections.title: Head count and missing crew
bullets: After sight and sound return, Sylan calls for a head count on the flying boat.
All four named crew members are found safe aboard; none fell or jumped off during the invisibility episode.
Ciri hides behind the mast or a barrel and is eventually accounted for.
Walker is not on the boat; he is away on his separate Sunder mission.
Mikkel the spymaster is not aboard again, continuing the recurring problem of departing without him.
The party discusses giving Mikkel a sending stone or teleportation tunnel so he can rejoin more reliably.

plotSections.title: Skipping Dana’s door study
bullets: Sylan offers Dana about thirty minutes to investigate the spectral door.
Dana’s player is not present, and the DM notes Dana lacks investigative spells such as detect magic.
The party decides not to wait and continues the journey as if nothing happened.

plotSections.title: The spectral door follows Gerk
bullets: As the ship resumes travel, the fake spectral door continues following Gerk rather than staying fixed in the sky.
It keeps roughly the same distance from Gerk as he moves around the ship.
When the ship sails forward, the door remains stationary relative to the ship, as if standing on it.
Gerk tries waving, verbal commands, closed sesame, and a performance of Bye Bye Bye (17 total) to dismiss it; nothing works.
Sylan tells Gerk to keep experimenting if he wants, but not to open another door until they are on land.

plotSections.title: Walker seeks the Haven Hold dragon
bullets: Walker reaches Quaylin’s Quax and learns the dragon whose hoard sits in the center of Haven Hold is the same one he has met before.
That dragon offers loans at very low interest rates.
Walker goes to speak with the male dragon, hoping for charity or a magical item he can afford.
Walker notes he left his money at home and likely has at least ten thousand gold there.

chronologicalEvents: Sylan organizes a head count; all four crew are found safe aboard.
Ciri is located hiding on the boat.
Sylan confirms Mikkel is not aboard.
Sylan cancels the planned wait for Dana’s door investigation because Dana is unavailable.
The party continues travel, pretending nothing happened.
The spectral door begins following Gerk and stays fixed on the ship as it moves.
Gerk fails to dismiss the door through physical, verbal, and performance attempts.
Sylan forbids Gerk from opening another door until they reach land.
Walker heads to the Haven Hold dragon at Quaylin’s Quax to ask for help or a loan.

Gerk.existing: Half-orc barbarian Doorman and Child of the Great Eldarin Tree.
notes: The spectral door now follows him rather than remaining behind in the sky.
It maintains roughly the same distance from him as he moves around the ship.
When the ship sails, the door stays stationary on the ship as if planted there.
Waving, commands, closed sesame, and a 17 performance check fail to dismiss or interact with it.
Agrees not to open another door until the party is on land.
quotesThemes: Go away door. We don't want you here.

notes: Runs a head count and searches for crew and party members after the dispel.
Offers Dana time to investigate the door, then drops the wait when she is unavailable.
Decides the party should continue as if nothing happened.
Guides Gerk to try dismissing the door with his Doorman powers but forbids opening new doors until landfall.
Expects Walker to message within about a day.
Is not present this session.
Does not have investigative magical spells such as detect magic available for the door study.
Hides behind the mast or a barrel during the head count.
Sylan calls her the party’s Whisper Master.
Remains covered in oil from his dragon vessel.
Gerk asks him to stand nearby instead of Sylan while tempers settle.

Walker.existing: Half-elf dragon rider bonded to Glimmen, Gatekeeper of The Reach.
notes: Is not on the boat; he is in Sunder near Quaylin’s Quax.
Seeks out the male Haven Hold dragon whose hoard he has interacted with before.
That dragon offers loans at very low interest.
Hopes the dragon will help him afford a magical item because he left his money at home.
Estimates he has at least ten thousand gold back home.

Spectral Door.existing: A mysterious spectral door resembling Gerk's shield form.
notes: Continues to follow Gerk after the party resumes travel.
Appears tied to Gerk rather than the ship, keeping roughly constant distance from him.
When the ship moves, the door stays fixed on the ship as if standing on it.
Remains non-interactable despite Gerk’s attempts to dismiss it.
Spymaster crew member who is not aboard again.
The party departed last time without verifying he was onboard.
Party considers a sending stone or teleportation tunnel so he can rejoin.
Shopkeeper of Quaylin’s Quax in Sunder.
Walker is directed toward the dragon associated with this shop and Haven Hold.
Contains a dragon hoard at its center.
The dragon there is the same one Walker has met before and offers low-interest loans.

Doorway.existing: A fixed supernatural passage between locations.
notes: Opening a doorway on the moving boat caused the earlier invisibility and silence effect.
The party agrees Gerk must not open another door until they reach land.
